description.default: Show fixed or optional holidays for a full year, month, date range, or upcoming period, optionally filtered by country and region. Fixed includes holidays previously classified as public or company. For all holidays this year or a given year, use view=year and pass year only if specified; this includes past holidays. For upcoming requests use view=upcoming. Omit country unless the user specifies it so the user's profile or browser location can supply the default. Do not use for working-day counts.
